title: Logically Sound Arguments for the Effectiveness of ML Safety Measures
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on the safety and formal verification of machine learning models for pedestrian detection in autonomous driving.
models_tested: Deep Neural Networks (DNN) for 2D object detection
findings: Not applicable. The paper's findings are related to safety arguments for machine learning in autonomous driving and do not pertain to religion or faith.
